Book 1 of 3

Alexis and the T-Rexes: Count to Ten

5.0 out of 5 on Amazon (14 ratings)

In their very first book, five-year-old Alexis and her baby dinosaur friends spend an exciting day together while learning to count to ten.

Get it on AmazonSee all 3 books

What kids get from it

  • Counting from one to ten, one number at a time
  • Matching numbers to things you can see and point at
  • Meeting Alexis, Snap and Daisy for the very first time

Try this after reading

Point to each dinosaur as you read and let your child say the number out loud. Then count something real together: toys, snacks or stairs.
